title: Drill 12: DMAS - Training ID 10
description: To refresh the DMT’s skill in the operation of DMAS Hypersat Unit
objectives: To refresh the DMT’s skill in the operation of DMAS Hypersat Unit
The participants will be able to discuss and perform the operation of DMAS Hypersat Unit.
Discuss and set up the DMAS Hypersat Unit.
Discuss the procedure for ECG monitoring, Blood Pressure monitoring, use of pulse oximeter and perform spirometry.
Able to demonstrate to hook up all equipment accessories to the patient.
materials: Training videos for the software of the DMAS Hypersat laptop. DMAS Hypersat Unit
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.

assessment.criteria: Meets and demonstrates the basic requirements.
Meets and Demonstrates a thorough understanding.
